note: Entry point for the fuzzer; receives attacker-controlled raw input bytes.
Allocates a heap buffer of size+1 bytes to hold the input as a NUL-terminated string.
Copies the fuzzer input into the heap buffer and NUL-terminates it.
Initializes espeak-ng with synchronous audio output; required before SSML processing.

code: espeak_Synth(buf, size, 0, POS_CHARACTER, 0, espeakCHARS_AUTO, NULL, NULL);
note: Passes the attacker-controlled buffer to espeak-ng's synthesis engine, which parses SSML/XML content.
Parses an SSML tag from the input; p points into the attacker-controlled buffer.
Iterates through the tag content until the closing '>' or end of string.
Checks for a double-quote character, which starts an attribute value.
Skips to the closing quote of the attribute value; if the input is malformed, p may advance past the end of the buffer.
After the inner loop, dereferences *p; if p advanced past the NUL terminator due to a missing closing quote, this reads out of bounds.
Continues scanning the tag; the out-of-bounds read propagates through subsequent iterations.
Loop termination; the malformed input causes a stack-buffer-overflow READ of 1 byte when *p is dereferenced beyond the allocated buffer.
